series: New listing #22, Oct 7; H02 lowball correction (benchmark: $22 vs $55 cleaning Short, 903 views)
hook: Charging $100 to wash a driveway? You're $67.80 short
hook_say: Here is what a $100 driveway wash really pays once the drive, the rig and self-employment tax are counted.

rows.label: Job
rows.why: The calculator's example job: a 2-car concrete driveway, picked from the Trade Presets list.

rows.label: Hours on site, people
rows.why: One person, an hour and a half on site, setup and cleanup included.

rows.label: Supplies, round-trip miles
rows.why: $12 of supplies and a 20-mile round trip: 40 minutes of driving at 30 mph and $15.20 of vehicle cost at 76 cents a mile.

rows.label: Your break-even per paid hour
rows.why: Pay divided by all hours says $27.78 an hour. Count the unpaid hours, $755 a month of costs and self-employment tax, and break-even is $64.89 per paid hour.

rows.label: Price floor, zero profit
rows.why: Labor on site $97.34, drive time $43.26, vehicle $15.20 and supplies $12: $167.80 just to cover your pay goal, costs and taxes.

rows.label: At $100 you are short by
rows.why: At $100 the job pays $67.80 less than it costs you. The check line says it in plain words: below your floor.

fix.label: Quote, rounded up to the next $5
fix.why: With a 15% profit margin, rounded up to the next $5, the quote is $200 with a $50 deposit. The Price Sheet does this for every job type at once.

note: Example numbers from the calculator. Yours go in the yellow cells.
